title: Random-subspace tests and trace smoothing for coordinate sweeps
summary: We prove that an absolute number of coordinate sweeps of the Thorp shuffle on $`n=2^d`$ positions brings the full permutation to total-variation distance at most $`\frac12n^{-5}`$ from uniform, uniformly over the initial deck. Thus $`O(d)`$ physical shuffles suffice, which is optimal in order.
family_title: Optimal logarithmic mixing of the Thorp shuffle

review.reason: Proves an O(d) total-variation mixing bound for coordinate sweeps of the Thorp shuffle.
